title: Wringer bundle digests
description: `digests.json` — a sha256 for every other file in a bundle. A SIBLING of manifest.json rather than a key inside it: `wringer.evidence.v1` shipped in v0.1.0 and is frozen, so the manifest cannot grow one, and a reader that does not know this file simply ignores it. The `prev_hash` chain makes the LEDGER tamper-evident and says nothing about the rest of the bundle — edit a gate's stdout.log and no chain notices. This is what lets `wring attest` claim 'proven by gates G, and none of it has been altered since' about the whole bundle.

algorithm.description: The digest algorithm. Named rather than assumed, so a future change is a value rather than a silent reinterpretation of every existing file.

files.description: Bundle-relative POSIX path -> hex digest. Written LAST, so it covers manifest.json and summary.md too. It cannot cover itself, and nothing on a disk its owner controls could: this is tamper-evidence, which turns a silent edit into a detectable one, not tamper-proofing.
